arrival_hub.accountHint: Dala i-akhawunti ukuze uhlanganyele. Ungabheka izindawo futhi uhlolle imisebenzi ngaphambi kokungena.
arrival_hub.communityHint: Izingxoxo zomphakathi, amaqelo aqhuba manje, nemilayezo eyimfihlo.
arrival_hub.economyHint: Thola umsebenzi, hwebisa imikhiqizo nezinsizakalo, uphathe iwallet yakho.
arrival_hub.intro: Hlolani umhlaba owenziwe ngokulingisa, landelani izinqumo zomphakathi, futhi tholani ukuthi imisebenzi yezifunda isebenza kanjani.
arrival_hub.learnHint: Landela uhambo oluholwayo, funda isifundo, noma ubuke ividiyo.
arrival_hub.placesHint: Bheka uhlu lwe-indawo yegunya kusukela emhlabeni kuya emiphakathini yasendaweni. Vula indawo ukuze uthole uhulumeni wayo namamephu esifunda sesishayamthetho.
arrival_hub.returnHint: Thola imicimbi yakho ezayo nomsebenzi wakho wamanje womphakathi.
arrival_hub.rolesHint: Bona umsebenzi womhlali, isishayamthetho, ijaji, usihlalo wekomiti, ilungu lebhodi lokukhetho, noma umphathi we-instance.
arrival_hub.title: Siyakwamukela
